name: tosijs-rooms
description: Realtime game rooms on a tosijs-platform host: make a room, share its code, relay messages between players.
author: Tonio Loewald

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build index.ts --target=browser --format=esm --sourcemap=linked --outdir=dist && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check-bun && bun test && bun run typecheck && bun run build
